_doc: Expression/mood axis (SPEC_PET_DESIGN_AXES §2) — universal: every animal has a face. MEASURED (Phase 3, 2026-07-16) as the STRONGEST axis, inverting the rev.3 risk call: all five options live at 0.85 on every cartoon-styled animal (grumpy and sleepy are outstanding), suffix position confirmed (§11.3 resolved). Style-dependent weakness on the realistic-styled bird: only grumpy+sleepy read there — a beak can't smile; that is semantics, not strength, so no min_strength. clause_slot 40: after the surface axis in suffix order.
